surfaces.name: Gov
surfaces.description: The signing queue — what Benny has proposed, what it rests on, and the decisions you have already made.

surfaces.name: Release
surfaces.description: What the estate has published and whether anyone can install it — feed coverage per platform, and the signed decision that publishing requires.

surfaces.name: Benny Record
surfaces.description: Replay how the pipeline produced any output — every model call, gate verdict, retrieval and ingest, step by step — with a token meter, gate chips, a model/ctx/commit badge, a live telemetry tail, and a lineage map that follows the current step.

surfaces.name: Lineage
surfaces.description: Total lineage — every subject the estate has recorded, its history step by step, and an honest measure of what is not recorded at all.

surfaces.name: Manifests
surfaces.description: Deterministic-zone manifest registry — inspect signed swarm manifests as DAGs.

surfaces.name: Bridge
surfaces.description: Mission control for the whole cognitive mesh — memory, documents, code, flows and runs on one page, with Benny in the dock.

surfaces.name: Deck
surfaces.description: The estate on a wall — one glanceable surface for what is waiting, what is proven, which machines are reporting, and what ran without authorisation.

surfaces.name: Mission Control
surfaces.description: The Command Center — live ecosystem rollup, system resources and capabilities, the file-memory heatmap, activity radar, and an omnibar across sessions, files, and actions.

surfaces.name: Lifelog
surfaces.description: A unified timeline of git commits and agent actions across all workspaces, with an activity radar that filters the feed by day.

surfaces.name: Memory
surfaces.description: The memory graph — your Claude + Antigravity agent sessions X-rayed into an explorable lineage map.

surfaces.name: Memory Setup
surfaces.description: Configure where the memory graph scans for agent activity — Claude, Antigravity, Gemini, and opencode log and config paths — with auto-detect status.

surfaces.name: Session Graph
surfaces.description: A full-canvas lineage explorer — pick a session and walk its recursive graph of inputs, thoughts, tool calls, and touched files.

surfaces.name: Step-Through
surfaces.description: Replay a session one action at a time — what happened, why, and the change it made — with playback, narration, and a lineage map that follows the current step.

surfaces.name: Time Travel
surfaces.description: Undo settings, spaces, and custom development changes.

surfaces.name: Agent
surfaces.description: Basic information and personal prompt tuning for the browser agent.

surfaces.name: Local LLM
surfaces.description: Load and test local LLMs with WebGPU and Hugging Face.

surfaces.name: User
surfaces.description: Update your full name and sign-in password.
